config.title: Build cron scheduler for periodic tasks

intro.title: Build cron scheduler for periodic tasks
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple cron scheduler in Node.js to run periodic tasks automatically. You will learn how to use the built-in `node-cron` package to schedule functions at specific time intervals. The core programming concepts involved include importing npm packages, defining scheduled tasks, and handling time-based execution. By the end, you'll have a working script that logs messages to the console on a recurring schedule.
intro.usecase: Cron schedulers are a fundamental backend pattern for automating periodic tasks in real-world software. You'll find them in production systems that send daily email digests, generate nightly financial reports, or clean up temporary data from databases. As a developer, you might build a dashboard that triggers these scheduled jobs or configure a system to run health checks every few minutes to ensure service reliability.

objectives: Initialize a Node.js project with required dependencies for cron scheduling
Configure a cron job using cron syntax to specify execution intervals
Implement a task function that executes at scheduled intervals
Control cron job lifecycle by starting and stopping scheduled tasks
Integrate error handling within cron jobs to manage task execution failures
Manipulate cron patterns to adjust task frequency and timing
Construct a scheduler that manages multiple periodic tasks simultaneously

steps.title: Schedule the task with a cron expression
steps.instruction: Call cron.schedule() with the cron expression '* * * * *' and your task function as arguments to schedule it to run every minute.
steps.hint: The cron.schedule() method takes two arguments: a cron expression string and the function to execute.
steps.expectedOutcome: The task function will be scheduled to run automatically every minute.
successCriteria: cron.schedule() is called with the cron expression '* * * * *' and the myTask function.

steps.title: Create a task management object
steps.instruction: Create an object named 'tasks' to store and manage all scheduled tasks with their metadata. The object should have properties for each task's name, description, cron expression, and function.
steps.hint: Define a plain JavaScript object with properties that hold the task details. You can use the existing task functions and cron expressions as values.
steps.expectedOutcome: You'll have a structured object that contains metadata for all your scheduled tasks, making them easier to manage and reference.
successCriteria: An object named 'tasks' is created with properties for task names, descriptions, cron expressions, and functions.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Nice! Proceed to the next step.

steps.feedbackWrong: The task management object wasn't created correctly. Review the instruction and create an object named 'tasks' with the specified properties.

steps.instruction: Modify the cron.schedule() call for myTask to include a timezone option set to 'America/New_York'.
steps.hint: The cron.schedule() method accepts an options object as its third parameter, where you can specify the timezone.
steps.expectedOutcome: The cron job for myTask will now run according to the 'America/New_York' timezone instead of the server's local time.
successCriteria: The cron.schedule() call includes a third parameter with a timezone property set to 'America/New_York'.
